_comment: Household-shape manifest for the /ny/prepare/ walkthrough. Each entry points at a self-contained tree.json. The renderer (assets/js/tree.js) offers a chooser when there is more than one shape, and loads a single shape directly. Add a shape = add an entry here plus its tree file; the renderer never changes.

shapes.label: Married or partnered, with minor children
shapes.blurb: Two parents. Guardianship, the joint-incapacity gap, and how the children's money is held.

shapes.label: Single parent, with minor children
shapes.blurb: No second parent to fall back on. Guardianship and the incapacity gap are the whole ballgame.
